Fixtures for ITR OCR pipeline tests.

These are synthetic fixtures generated by `scripts/itr/generate-fixtures.mjs` so we can test end-to-end extraction without any real user documents.

- `form16_clean.pdf` (selectable text)
- `form16_scanned.jpg` (image OCR)
- `ais_sample.pdf` (selectable text)
- `bank_interest.pdf` (selectable text)

Run: `node scripts/itr/generate-fixtures.mjs`
